reasons.visit-the-boneyard-blue: Recovers a high-power attack, sets up a stronger clash reveal, and creates Vigor, with a six-base-power target also enabling Headstrong Stampede.
reasons.rip-off-the-top-yellow: Can establish the six-power pitch card needed by Buckwild, High Pitched Howl, and Vigorous Roar while also boosting the next attack.
reasons.agile-windup-red: Its self-discard creates Agility and, if its Kayo-adjusted power reaches six, can also trigger Kayo's Might and enable Mandible Claw's go again.
reasons.trade-in-red: Lets you deliberately discard a qualifying six-power card to enable Kayo and Mandible Claw, replaces that card, and gains go again from arsenal.
reasons.sigil-of-cycles-blue: Its action-phase discard can enable Kayo and Mandible Claw before you attack while replacing the discarded card.
reasons.mighty-windup-red: Its self-discard creates Might and, when it qualifies as six power during your action phase, can produce Kayo's additional Might and enable Mandible Claw.
reasons.barraging-beatdown-red: Intimidate makes Barraging Big Horn's go again harder to deny, while the conditional +4 power also pressures opponents to commit additional defenders.
reasons.awakening-bellow-red: Combines intimidate with +3 power to support Barraging Big Horn's defense-count condition and make Strongest Survive's discard threat harder to avoid.
reasons.lead-with-speed-red: Boosts a Brute attack by +3 while creating Agility to support the deck's multi-attack strategy.
reasons.reincarnate-red: The deck's numerous random-discard effects turn its bottom-deck replacement into a way to preserve attack cards for later draws.
